25001.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Barnstable County runs $38 an acre for 2026, the lowest of 11 in Massachusetts and well under the $78 state median. Irrigated ground tells another story at $433 an acre for 2026, 2nd highest of 7. The census value of land and buildings hit $58,917 an acre in 2022, up 92.8% from $30,555 in 2017 and far above the $14,377 state median. Renters work 22% of the farmland here.

25003.story: As of Oct 16, cropland rent in Berkshire County runs $58 an acre for 2026, 3rd lowest of 11 in Massachusetts and under the state median of $78. That rent is up 96.6% from $30 in 2016. The census value of land and buildings was $8,606 an acre in 2022, up 12.6% from $7,644 in 2017 and the lowest of 9 in the state. Only 14% of farmland here was rented in 2022.

Rented ground made up 22% of farmland in 2022.
